description: Returns the full schema of one SDK method in one language: signature, parameters, return type, doc comment, example, the SDK version that added it, notes, and the SDK types the signature uses (fields included). Identify the method by canonical id ("events.create", "client.constructor", "client.onTokensRefreshed"), by the language method name ("ListAsync"), or "resource.method". A helper that is not a client method (webhooks.verifyWebhookSignature) carries callAs. Python methods carry their async-client twin.
name: getConnectSdkMethod
title: Get Connect SDK Method
